details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept that registers an install-time beacon. Its package.json postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required. The beacon sends an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing only the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), the Node version string and the protocol, plus an X-Beacon-Package header carrying the package name. TLS certificate validation is disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false), requests time out after 5s and errors are swallowed so install succeeds silently. No environment values, tokens, credential files, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, no child processes are spawned and no second-stage code is downloaded; the payload is limited to install/host fingerprinting and the callback. index.js exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the name do not crash. The README states the package is published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test.
